newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MBE unit in Manila money transfer venture.
newsitem.headline: MBE unit in Manila money transfer venture.

text.p: The Philippine subsidiary of Mail Boxes Etc (MBE) said on Tuesday it would operate a money transfer business with M. Lhuillier Inc, a leading local pawnshop and jewellery firm.
MBE Philippines is an authorised agent of Western Union, which is one of the world's biggest money transfer agents. Western Union is a unit of First Data Corp.
MBE is involved in retail postal, business support and communications services. M. Lhuillier has about 300 branches nationwide.

"The tie-up presents a mutual opportunity for both MBE and M. Lhullier as it effectively marries MBE's extensive global network with M. Lhullier's nationwide chain," MBE Philippines chairman Hector Yango said in a statement.
M. Lhuillier vice president Charles Andre Lhuillier said the company hoped to cash in on the lucrative money remittance business due to the large number of Filipinos working overseas.
